sloka: हिंसाभिरुचयो हिंस्युरिमां वा जनकात्मजाम् ।विपन्नं स्यात्ततः कार्यं रामसुग्रीवयोरिदम् ।। ५.३०.३०।।।।
transliteration: hiṁsābhirucayo hiṁsyurimāṁ vā janakātmajām ।vipannaṁ syāttataḥ kāryaṁ rāmasugrīvayoridam ।। 5.30.30।।।।

translations.english: "These demons who are keen on indulging in violence will harm Janaka's daughter. Then the mission of Rama and Sugriva will also fail.
